_note: Lukio courses and the matriculation exams (GDD 4.9.3, session S3b; scripts/core/lukio.gd, scripts/core/matriculation.gd, SchoolSystem). REAL facts carry `src` (the sources at the end, each read on the date given); everything marked `estimated` is Claude's first guess, tuned in B1. A 'course' in the game is a 2-credit study unit (opintojakso): the decree counts credits (opintopisteet), and a school must let a student take the national optional studies as 2-credit units (decree 810/2018 12 §), so 150 credits = 75 courses (the old '75 courses' of the 2003 curriculum, src 4). Course names are the game's own ('Finnish 3'); the national module codes are not used. Grades 8-9 and the 10th grade are untouched by this file: it acts only in a lukio stage (data/school_life.json stages.secondary lukio / urheilulukio).

decree._note: Valtioneuvoston asetus lukiokoulutuksesta 810/2018, Annex 1 (the youth syllabus), as in force on 2026-10-17 (src 1). compulsory = pakolliset opinnot in credits, optional = the national optional studies (valtakunnalliset valinnaiset) a school must offer, in credits. Music and art: 6 credits together, each 2 or 4. Thematic studies are national optional only. B2 / B3 languages: 16 + 16 credits offered, all optional.

rules._note: The rules the game follows. src 3 = Mäkelänrinne's guide 2026-27 (a sports lukio in Helsinki; its rules are the school's own, used for every school, marked `estimated` where only that school is the source).
rules.years_note: Lukio takes 2-4 years (src 3: 'the whole syllabus and the matriculation exams in at least two and at most four years'). The game offers 3 or 4 years in every lukio (user 2026-10-17), chosen at the start and changeable on the School page until year 3 starts.
rules.subject_grade: the average of the subject's compulsory and national optional course grades (src 3), rounded to a whole grade
rules.coaching_note: A sports lukio student takes 24 credits = 12 courses of sports coaching (Mäkelänrinne: urheiluvalmennus 24; Lahden lyseo: at least 12 coaching courses = 24 credits). They are the morning practice: no classroom load, graded passed.

drop.note: A sports lukio student with at least 24 coaching credits may leave out 16 credits (8 courses) of compulsory courses; at least half of each compulsory subject's compulsory courses must still be taken, and none of a subject the student takes a matriculation exam in (src 3). User 2026-10-17: the player chooses, in the period's course stop.

fail_allowance.note: The number of failed (4) credits a subject may have: 2-5 credits none, 6-11 at most 2, 12-17 at most 4, 18+ at most 6 (src 3). The game retakes every failed course in the next period's exam week instead (simplification: a failed subject is never left).

subjects._note: The lukio subjects of the game. comp / opt = compulsory and national optional COURSES (decree credits / 2; maths: `common` + the syllabus). from = the grade 8-9 subjects whose levels start this subject (averaged; new subjects such as philosophy start from their relatives). kind: academic (an exam at the end of each course, graded 4-10), practical (graded from the term's work, 4-10), pass (passed / not, no grade). exam = the matriculation exam of the subject (data `matric.exams`).
subjects.music_art_note: Music and art are 3 compulsory courses together (6 credits, each 2 or 4: decree): one each, and the third goes to the one you are better at.

languages.name: No extra language
languages.text: Only the languages you already have: English and Swedish.

languages.name: German
languages.text: A new language from scratch: 8 optional courses over lukio, and you could take its exam (short syllabus).

languages.name: French
languages.text: A new language from scratch: 8 optional courses over lukio, and you could take its exam (short syllabus).

languages.name: Spanish
languages.text: A new language from scratch: 8 optional courses over lukio, and you could take its exam (short syllabus).

levels._note: Where a subject stands when lukio starts (estimated): the average of its `from` subjects' levels + the subject's own shift + lukio_shift (lukio grades run lower than grade 9's: an estimate, not a measured fact) + for long maths long_maths_shift (the harder syllabus). New subjects get an aptitude roll (sd) around that. Their natural level moves the same way, so grades keep drifting with the study effort as before.

plan._note: The study counsellor's plan (GDD 4.9.3 S3b; estimated except the rules above). The 75 courses of the whole lukio are spread over its periods (5 a school year, data/school.json rules.lukio_periods) by year_share (year 1 at least 30 courses, src 3) and in the last year by last_year_periods (the abi spring: courses end before the exams). Inside the plan each subject's courses are spread so its last course ends before the subject's exam session. Optional courses: first those of the exam subjects (to the session), then the subjects you are best at, until 75. load_per_course = the life load of a school day for each classroom course above (below) normal_courses in the period (coaching courses are training, not classroom: they don't count).

courses._note: A course's grade (estimated): an academic course has its exam in the period's exam week (one exam per course, the days of the exam week dealt out by the career's dice), graded like the grade 8-9 tests (school_life.json tests: level + a roll - stress); the course grade = round(exam_weight x the exam + (1 - exam_weight) x the level), 4-10. Practical courses: round(level). Pass courses: passed. A 4 is retaken in the next period's exam week (the better grade counts).

matric._note: The matriculation examination (ylioppilastutkinto). Rules from the board's page (src 2): at least five exams; mother tongue and literature for everyone; at least four more from at least three of the groups maths / second national language / foreign language / realia; at least one exam of the long syllabus; two syllabuses of one subject count once; the required exams within at most THREE CONSECUTIVE SESSIONS (also in a 4-year lukio: a 4th session only retakes); a failed exam can be retaken three times in the next three sessions; a passed exam can be retaken freely; a no-show is a failed exam that cannot be compensated. Exam days: data/school.json matriculation (the verified sessions) and rules.matriculation (later years, estimated). The two realia days of a session (realia_a / realia_b) take one subject each. Compensation of a failed exam by the other exams' points is NOT built (S3b): a failed required exam is retaken.

score._note: An exam's score (estimated): the subject's level + bonus_per_optional for each optional course done in it (at most bonus_max: src 3 says the national optional courses of an exam subject are what makes a good result possible) + a roll (sd) - stress (as the course exams) - the week's meet-and-tests penalty. Finnish: the average of its two parts. The grade = the first of `thresholds` the score reaches (L, E, M, C, B, A; below the last = I). The thresholds are FITTED by tools/school_check.gd part 16 so the game's lukio students (the five school answers equally, Normal effort) get about the board's shares above.

registration._note: Binding registration through the school (src 6): one school's 2025-26 deadlines were 20 Nov (spring) and 20 May (autumn); another's 1 Dec 2026 and 25 May 2026. The game uses 20 Nov / 20 May for every school (estimated). The stop to confirm a session's exams comes stop_days_before the deadline (user: a stop per session).

results._note: Results to the students: spring 2027 on 19 May (school.json, verified); other sessions results_days after the session's first exam day (spring 2027: 16 Mar + 64 days = 19 May; the autumn rule is an estimate).

matric.estimated_note: life_load = the school life load of an exam day (estimated: six hours of writing); stress_news = the stress news on the Sunday before a week with an exam.

stops._note: The lukio's stops (only with SchoolSystem.decisions_enabled, i.e. the real game: every tool gets the defaults and never a stop). An answer that is not an option id = the default in brackets.
stops.maths_text: Lukio starts. First, maths: the long syllabus (10 compulsory courses, harder, and its exam counts as a long-syllabus exam) or the short one (6 courses, easier)? You can move from long to short later, not back.

long.label: Long maths
long.detail: More courses and lower grades, but the most demanding maths there is.

short.label: Short maths
short.detail: Fewer, easier courses: more room for other subjects.

stops.language_text: Do you want to start a new language? It is optional: 8 courses spread over lukio, with an exam you can take.
stops.years_text: Lukio can take three or four years. Four years means fewer courses in each period, so lighter school days, but you finish a year later. You can change this until your third year starts.

3.label: Three years
3.detail: The usual pace: about five courses a period.

4.label: Four years
4.detail: About four courses a period: lighter school days, one more year.

stops.register_text: Registration for the {session} exams closes on {date}. Check your exams for that session: after the deadline they are fixed.

coach_lines.autumn: September is after the summer's big meets. Put the heavy exams in the autumn if you can.
coach_lines.spring: The spring exams are in March and April: the outdoor season is still ahead, we can make room.

stops.exam_text: Today is the {exam} exam{part}: six hours from 9:00. {race}
stops.exam_race: You are also entered in {meet} today: you can't do both. Sit the exam and the race is withdrawn.

sit.label: Sit the exam
sit.detail: You write it. The grade comes with the results.

skip.label: Skip it
skip.detail: A no-show: the exam counts as failed and you retake it at a later session.

stops.matric_results_text: The results of the {session} exams are out:
stops.matric_results_retake: Failed exams can be retaken at the next session.
stops.certificate_text: You have passed the matriculation examination and finished lukio. Your exams:
stops.certificate_wait: The lukio courses are done, but your matriculation exams are not passed yet: you finish when they are.

ui._note: Everything the player reads about lukio on the School page and in the stop panels (session S3b).

ui.drop_text: With your coaching courses you may leave out up to {max} compulsory courses (not in an exam subject, at least half of each subject).
ui.nothing_to_add: Nothing more to add this period.

ui.rule_groups: From at least {n} groups besides Finnish ({have})

not_verified: The lukio grade shift (lukio grades about half a grade to a grade below grade 9's): an estimate, no source read.
One school's rules (Mäkelänrinne's guide) are used for every lukio: the fail allowance, the 60 credits of year 1, the dropping of 16 credits in a sports lukio.
The registration deadlines are those of two schools (src 6), not the board's.
The grade shares are the familiar bell curve (src 5, a secondary source); the board sets the limits per exam each session.

sources.facts: Valtioneuvoston asetus lukiokoulutuksesta 810/2018 (in force, amended 124/2021): Annex 1 compulsory and national optional credits per subject (above), compulsory 94 or 102, national optional at least 20, total at least 150; 12 §: national optional studies must be available as 2-credit units; 17 §: grades 4-10, 4 = failed; 13 §: A, B1, B2, B3 languages

Matriculation Examination Board: at least five exams; mother tongue for all; four more from at least three of maths / second national language / foreign language / realia; at least one long-syllabus exam; two syllabuses of a subject count once; within at most three consecutive sessions; a failed exam retaken three times in the next three sessions; passed exams retaken freely; compensation; a no-show cannot be compensated

Mäkelänrinne lukio guide 2026-27: lukio in 2-4 years (a 5th by the principal's leave), the plan made for three years, at least 60 credits in the first year, subject grade = average of compulsory + national optional course grades, fail allowances by credits, the timetable (urheiluvalmennus 24 credits), a sports lukio student with 24 coaching credits may leave out 16 credits of compulsory courses (at least half of each compulsory subject, never in exam subjects), the matriculation rules repeated, two realia days per session, national optional courses in the exam subjects 'make a successful exam possible'

Finnish National Agency for Education, 'Lukion opetussuunnitelman perusteet pähkinänkuoressa' (LOPS 2021): at least 150 credits instead of the former 75 courses; national studies as modules that schools build into study units; assessed per study unit
matriculation grades L 7 points top 5 %, E 6 15 %, M 5 20 %, C 4 24 %, B 3 20 %, A 2 11 %, I 0 bottom 5 % (bell-curve grading; a secondary source)
registration deadlines: Oulu (spring 2026 exams by 20 Nov 2025, autumn 2026 by 20 May 2026); Alavuden lukio (peda.net, autumn 2026 by 25 May 2026, spring 2027 by 1 Dec 2026); registration is binding
Lahden lyseo: students take at least 12 coaching courses (24 credits) (also urheilulukiot.json source 17)
